title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十四章 困兽云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十五章 恩仇
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
林灵素经脉俱断，只是靠两伤法术聚气强撑，与他激斗了百余合，又被这混金铜藤球与凶兽恶灵接连猛击，纵是钢筋铁骨也抵受不住。身子一晃，坐倒在地，嘿然道：“原来那老怪物的法宝是你偷了去，难怪当日老子左寻右找也见不着。你处心积虑这么多年，倒也难为你了。”
王文卿道：“彼此彼此。”
他搀扶起那小王爷，将一颗丹丸送入其口中，又将真气绵绵输入，道：“王爷，你吞了这颗‘太乙丸’，在这里静心调息三个时辰，便无大恙。船舰暂且交给贫道调度指挥。”
李少微格格笑道：“‘冰魄花粉’号称天下第七奇毒，唯有‘南荒火蝶’可解。冲和子随手炼制的丹丸竟然就能祛除，可真是神农再世，黄帝重生了……”她面无血色，气息不继，笑了几声便转为剧烈的咳嗽。
王文卿也不理会，命众弟子围坐在小王爷四周，横剑布阵，又将六颗“太乙丸”送与其中几个弟子服下，道：“此毒虽然阴寒森厉，让人经脉俱痹，难以动弹，却好在没有性命之虞。你们只管凝神调气，保护好小王爷，不可轻举妄动。无论他们说什么，也不要靠近混金铜笼三丈之内，以免被他的‘盗丹大法’所吸，妄送性命。等到了蓬山，为师自有法子解尽余毒。”又仔细嘱咐了一番，方用拂尘卷起炼天石图，领着两个弟子出舱门而去。
许宣失望已极，原以为林灵素既然敢上贼船，必有必胜之把握，没想到技穷于此，又急又怒，叫道：“姓王的！你好歹也是大宋子民，勾结鞑子，祸及殃民，算得上什么修真道士？再不弃暗投明，悔过自新，小心被雷电劈死！”
雷声轰鸣，舱门哐然紧闭，王文卿早去得远了。
林灵素哈哈笑道：“小子，你跟他扯仁义道德有个屁用？只要能得道飞升，别说欺师灭祖、背信弃义，就是亲爹亲娘，姓王的也能狠心即刻宰了，不眨一下眼睛。否则又怎会拍拍屁股溜之大吉，留下这群笨蛋自生自灭？”
众道士听若不闻，依照王文卿所嘱，横剑于膝，双手两两相连，凝神御气。那太乙丸果似有些功效，过了一会儿，服了丹丸的六个道士脸色稍转红润，身上所凝结的冰霜也渐渐消融。
小青蜷在许宣怀里，低声**，浑身打颤，肌肤上已泛出淡淡的鳞光。她原是冷血之身，寒毒未消，又中了这花粉，可谓雪上加霜。
许宣一凛，下意识地伸手抓住她的脉门，想要为她传输真气，指尖刚触及她的手腕，忽然一怔：“我可以动了？”又惊又喜。岂料念头未已，丹田蓦地一阵绞痛，金星乱舞，险些晕厥。
却不知他从小在药罐子里泡大，许正亭为了给他治病，也不知喂了多少灵草妙药，以毒攻毒，早已近乎百毒不侵，更何况还有“元婴金丹”所化成的真炁护体。
当初李少微的“九转寒冰箭”也罢，后来的“销魂断魄香”也好，即便这极为罕见霸道的“冰魄花粉”，到了他的体内，被血液内的种种药毒冲抵，也只能逞一时之威。是以过不多久，双手便已能活动。
只是他不懂得御气排毒之道，急着运转真气，反倒将残余的寒毒送入了丹田、经脉，顿时又动弹不得。
几在同时，船身猛地一阵剧晃，灯火摇曳，桌案上的杯碗酒瓶倾斜滑移，众人也跟着东摇西摆。显是已转舵变向，朝着那“青龙皮图”所标识的方位逆风航行。
林灵素眯起双眼，凝神聆听了片刻，嘿然道：“很好，照此速度，天亮之前便可到蓬莱了。”转过头，乜斜着混金铜笼内那盘坐发抖的两个道士，上下打量，啧啧赞道：“妙极，妙极。”
那两人不知他所谓的“妙极”指的是什么，被他瞧得毛骨悚然，忐忑不安。
林灵素突然翻身冲起，右手闪电似的插入左边道士的肚子，一把将肝胆血淋淋地抓了出来。
许宣猛吃一惊，舱内惊哗四起，那道士张大嘴骇然地看着自己，过了一会儿才发出一声凄厉的惨呼，仆倒在地。右边的道士吓得面如土色，连滚带爬地退到角落，紧握长剑，浑身发抖。
林灵素挑起地上的长剑，反手将自己胸腹切开，众人惊呼声中，竟将自己的肝扯了出来，抛在地上，将那道士的肝胆塞了进去。

众道士脸色齐变，纷纷叫道：“百衲之身！”
金国鞑子们何曾见过这等血腥的景象？瞠目结舌者有之，伏地干呕者有之，就连小青这等心狠手辣的妖女，也睁大了妙目，讶异无已。
林灵素被鲜血染得半身尽红，却若无其事，笑道：“肝太肥，胆太小，好在完整无损，暂且借来用用。”撕下衣袖，指尖疾弹，丝线“咻咻”飞舞，很快便将胸腹缝合整齐。
当日在成都牢内，许宣便曾亲身体验这开膛破肚、更换脏腑的滋味儿，此时目睹，更觉惊心动魄。常人的心肺肝胆受到重创，必死无疑，这魔头却能随心所欲地更换。所幸经脉与脏器不同，看不见摸不着，无从换起，否则这魔头可真成了不死之身了！
content_en:
Lin Lingsu's meridians were all severed, and she only relied on two damage spells to gather energy to hold on. She fought with him for more than a hundred times, and was hit hard by the gold-copper takraw ball and the ferocious beast and evil spirit one after another. Even the steel and iron bones could not withstand it. He swayed, sat down on the ground, and said cheerfully: "It turns out that you stole the old monster's magic weapon. No wonder I couldn't find it when I looked around for it. You have been planning it for so many years, so it's hard for you."
Wang Wenqing said: "To each other."
He helped the young prince up, put a pill into his mouth, and poured in his true energy, saying: "Your Majesty, if you swallow this 'Taiyi Pill' and meditate here for three hours, you will be fine. The ship will be handed over to Pindao for the time being."
Li Shaowei chuckled and said: "'Ice Soul Pollen' is known as the seventh most strange poison in the world, and can only be cured by the 'Southern Wilderness Fire Butterfly'. The pills that Chong Hezi refined at random can actually remove it. It is really the reincarnation of Shennong and the rebirth of the Yellow Emperor..." Her face was pale, her breath was breathless, and she laughed a few times before turning into a violent cough.
Wang Wenqing ignored it and ordered all the disciples to sit around the young prince, set up a formation with horizontal swords, and gave six "Taiyi Pills" to several of the disciples to take, saying: "Although this poison is cold and severe, paralyzing the meridians and making it difficult to move, but fortunately there is no danger of life. Just focus on regulating your energy and protect the young prince, no. Don't act rashly. No matter what they say, don't come within three feet of the gold-mixed copper cage, so as not to be sucked by his 'Elixir Stealing Technique' and risk your life. When we get to Pengshan, I will have my own way to remove the remaining poison." After giving some careful instructions, Fang used a duster to roll up the Sky Refining Stone Diagram and led the two disciples out of the cabin.
Xu Xuan was extremely disappointed. He thought that since Lin Lingsu dared to board the pirate ship, he would be sure of victory. Unexpectedly, he was so incompetent that he became anxious and angry. He shouted: "Wang! You are also a citizen of the Song Dynasty after all. You colluded with the Tatars and brought disaster to the people. What kind of Taoist priest are you? If you don't abandon the dark side and repent, you may be struck to death by lightning!"
Thunder roared and the cabin door slammed shut. Wang Wenqing was already far away.
Lin Lingsu laughed and said: "Boy, what's the point of talking about benevolence, righteousness and morality? As long as you can achieve enlightenment and ascend, let alone deceive your master, destroy your ancestors, and betray your trust, even your own father and mother, surnamed Wang, can be ruthlessly killed immediately without blinking an eye. Otherwise, how could you just slap your butt and run away, leaving these idiots to fend for themselves?"
All the Taoist priests ignored this, and followed Wang Wenqing's instructions, holding their swords across their knees, connecting their hands two by two, and concentrating on controlling their energy. The Taiyi pill seemed to have some effect. After a while, the faces of the six Taoist priests who took the pill turned slightly rosy, and the frost on their bodies gradually melted away.
Xiaoqing curled up in Xu Xuan's arms, whispering, trembling all over, and a faint scaly light appeared on her skin. She was originally cold-blooded, but the cold poison had not gone away, and she was infected with this pollen, which made her even worse.
Xu Xuan was startled, and subconsciously reached out to grab her pulse gate, hoping to transmit the true energy to her. As soon as his fingertips touched her wrist, he suddenly started to say, "Can I move?" He was surprised and happy. Unexpectedly, before he could finish his thoughts, he felt a sudden cramping in his Dantian, Venus danced wildly, and he almost fainted.
Little did they know that he had been soaked in medicine jars since he was a child. In order to cure his illness, Xu Zhengting also fed him an unknown number of magical herbs and magical medicines. He used poison to fight poison, and he was almost invulnerable to all poisons, not to mention the true energy protection formed by the "Nascent Soul Golden Pill".
Whether it was Li Shaowei's "Nine-turn Ice Arrow" or the later "Ecstasy Fragrance", even if this extremely rare and domineering "Ice Soul Pollen" entered his body, it would be neutralized by various poisons in the blood, and it would only be able to show its power for a short time. Therefore, it didn't take long before his hands could move.
It's just that he didn't know how to control Qi and detoxify, and in his rush to circulate Qi, he instead sent the remaining cold poison into his Dantian and meridians, and he was immediately unable to move.
Almost at the same time, the ship's hull shook violently, the lights swayed, the cups, bowls, and wine bottles on the table tilted and slid, and everyone swayed here and there as well. Apparently the rudder has been turneddirection, sailing against the wind toward the direction marked by the "Qinglong Pitu".
Lin Lingsu narrowed her eyes, listened intently for a moment, and said happily: "Very good, at this speed, we can reach Penglai before dawn." Turning his head, he looked at the two trembling Taoist priests who were sitting cross-legged in the mixed gold and copper cage, looked up and down, and praised: "Excellent, excellent."
The two people didn't know what he meant by "wonderful", and they looked at him with horror and uneasiness.
Lin Lingsu suddenly turned over and rushed up, inserting his right hand into the stomach of the Taoist priest on the left like lightning, and grabbed out the liver and gallbladder bloody.
Xu Xuan was startled, and there was an uproar in the cabin. The Taoist priest opened his mouth wide and looked at him in shock. After a while, he let out a shrill scream and fell to the ground. The Taoist priest on the right was so frightened that his face turned pale. He rolled and crawled back to the corner, holding his sword tightly and trembling all over.
Lin Lingsu picked up the long sword on the ground and cut open his chest and abdomen with his backhand. As everyone screamed, he pulled out his liver, threw it on the ground, and stuffed the Taoist priest's liver and gallbladder inside.
The expressions of all the Taoist priests changed, and they all shouted: "The body of hundreds of monks!"
Have the Jin Kingdom Tatars ever seen such a bloody scene? Some were dumbfounded, some fell to the ground and retched. Even cruel witches like Xiao Qing opened their eyes wide in surprise.
Lin Lingsu's body was stained red with blood, but he remained calm and said with a smile: "The liver is too fat and the courage is too small. Fortunately, it is intact, so I can borrow it for now." He tore off his sleeves, flicked his fingertips quickly, and the silk threads flew "swish", and he quickly sewed his chest and abdomen neatly.
That day in the Chengdu prison, Xu Xuan had personally experienced the feeling of disemboweling the body and replacing the internal organs. Seeing it now, he found it even more thrilling. An ordinary person's heart, lungs, liver and gallbladder would be severely damaged and they would definitely die, but this demon can be replaced at will. Fortunately, the meridians are different from the internal organs. They cannot be seen or touched, and there is no way to replace them. Otherwise, this demon would really have become immortal!
